elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9.1 requires only compliance with Performance Standards or performance in a commercially reasonable manner, expressly with no higher degree of care; it does not provide a professional-and-workmanlike warranty.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: The added language warrants that software used to provide the Services will conform in all material respects to its documentation.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only 90 days.
The 90-day period applies only to software conformance; no 90-day Services warranty is stated.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The remedies expressly include, at M&I's option, repair or replacement of non-conforming software or Services.
The remedies expressly include a refund of fees paid for non-conforming software or Services.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws appears in the rendered language.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No warranty concerning malicious code appears in the rendered language.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: M&I warrants software conformance to documentation for at least 90 days from first use to provide the Services.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: No Services warranty with a duration of at least 30 days is provided; the stated 90-day period applies only to software conformance.
